title: Police Blotter: 21 booked in Webb County — end-of-day roundup
excerpt: 21 people were booked into the Webb County Jail on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds on Friday night and Saturday, Oct. 30–31, 2026 — including 11 alleged DWI bookings. Every arrest is an allegation; each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
content:
Twenty-one people were booked into the Webb County Jail on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds on Friday night and Saturday, October 30–31, 2026, according to Webb County booking records. Each person is listed below with the charge shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.
